Project description 
 VR-122132
 Our customer is a top-tier investment bank with client assets of hundreds of billions globally.
 Reason to join us
 • We offer the opportunity to work in a highly professional environment where you will work with high-level financial instruments
 • We want you to be part of our success story and give you reasons to be proud of what you achieved as part of our fabulous team
 • We allow you to develop yourself and evolve in your career via our fantastic technical, business-related, or soft skills training
 • We encourage creative thinking in our great open-minded work environment. Frequently, the relaxation rooms are the place where the most ambitious ideas are born.
 • We are not just professional teams, we are also friends who have fun working together
 • As a Senior Virtual Devices DevOps Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and deployment pipelines that support virtual device platforms. You will leverage Citrix, Azure Cloud, and Terraform to build scalable, secure, and resilient systems in collaboration with developers, architects, and site reliability teams.
 Mandatory office attendance - 3 days per week.
 Responsibilities 
 Architect and manage Citrix-based solutions for virtual desktop/application delivery.
 Design, deploy, and optimize cloud infrastructure on Azure using
 Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
 Develop IaC modules, resource provisioning, and environment lifecycle management.
 Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications.
 Automate system configuration, deployment, monitoring, and scaling.
 Ensure security, compliance, high availability, and cost optimization across platforms.
 Mentor junior engineers and advocate DevOps best practices.
 Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and post-mortem processes.
 Skills 
 Must have
 6+ years in infrastructure/DevOps roles, including experience as a Senior Engineer.
 Proficient with Citrix architecture, administration, and troubleshooting.
 Strong hands-on experience with Azure Cloud services and architecture.
 Expert-level proficiency in Terraform for designing and managing IaC.
 Solid scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other).
 Experience building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
 Knowledge of container platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
 Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor.
 Nice to have
 Experience with Ansible, ARM, or cloud cost tools.
 Knowledge of networking, security architectures, or hybrid-cloud setups.
